stories.title: Trump duyurdu: Rusya ve Ukrayna enerji altyapılarını vurmayacak

en.title: Trump announces: Russia and Ukraine will not strike each other's energy infrastructure
en.summary: Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine have agreed not to target each other's energy facilities.

en.title: Internet personality Çağla Öz arrested
en.summary: Çağla Öz, spouse of "Kara Haydar" known for viral jewelry videos from Van, was arrested and remanded to prison.

stories.title: Polis aracına çarpıp kaçan sürücü tutuklandı

en.title: Driver who hit police vehicle and fled arrested
en.summary: A driver who ignored police signals and fled after hitting a police vehicle in Keçiören has been arrested.

en.title: Body found off Silivri coast
en.summary: A body discovered in the sea off Silivri, determined to have been in the water for an extended period, has not been identified.

stories.title: Silivri açıklarında ceset bulundu: Kimliği belirlenemedi

en.title: Body found off Silivri: Identity could not be determined
en.summary: A body was discovered in waters off Silivri and has been sent to the forensic medicine institute for identification and determination of cause of death.

stories.title: Diyarbakır'da Bilal Erdoğan'a Demirtaş sorusu! Verdiği yanıt gündem oldu

en.title: Bilal Erdoğan asked about Demirtaş in Diyarbakır! His response became a topic of discussion
en.summary: During a visit to Diyarbakır, Bilal Erdoğan, son of President Erdoğan, received a question regarding Selahattin Demirtaş and gave a response that generated public attention.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA I Trump duyurdu: “Ukrayna, Rus enerji hedeflerini vurmayacak”

en.title: BREAKING: Trump announces: "Ukraine will not strike Russian energy targets"
en.summary: U.S. President Trump announced on social media that Ukraine has agreed not to strike Russian energy infrastructure, and referenced global diesel price increases.

en.title: Circular from Akın Gürlek to 81 provinces: emphasis on 'desexualization'
en.summary: Justice Minister Akın Gürlek sent a circular to 175 heavy criminal prosecution offices instructing them to investigate activities deemed to promote desexualization of children and youth, and to initiate legal proceedings if criminal connections are found.

stories.title: Akın Gürlek imzaladı: 81 İle genelge gönderildi

en.title: Akın Gürlek signed: Circular sent to 81 provinces
en.summary: The Justice Ministry sent instructions to chief prosecutors in all 81 provinces regarding matters related to children and youth.

stories.title: Bilal Erdoğan ve Sakızcı Memo arasında 'Selahattin Demirtaş' diyaloğu: 'Onlar benim bildiğim işler değil...'

en.title: Dialogue between Bilal Erdoğan and "Sakızcı Memo" about Selahattin Demirtaş: "Those are not matters I deal with..."
en.summary: A citizen asked Bilal Erdoğan to release Selahattin Demirtaş, and Erdoğan responded that such matters were outside his purview.

stories.title: Üç okul tek binaya sıkıştırıldı: Veliler isyan etti

en.title: Three schools squeezed into one building: Parents protest
en.summary: Students from schools scheduled for demolition due to earthquake risk in İzmir's Konak district were relocated to another school building.

stories.title: İzmir'de 3 okul tek binaya sığdırıldı: Veliler isyan etti

en.title: Three schools fit into one building in İzmir: Parents protest
en.summary: Three schools began sharing one building after students from demolished-risk schools in Konak were transferred, causing congestion and parental complaints on the first day.

stories.title: Fenerbahçe'nin Gaziantep FK karşısındaki ilk 11'i belli oldu

en.title: Fenerbahçe's starting lineup against Gaziantep FK confirmed
en.summary: Fenerbahçe will face Gaziantep FK away in the closing match of the 5th week of the Trendyol Super League. The starting lineups for both teams have been announced.

en.title: Istanbul Stock Exchange closes day in decline
en.summary: The BIST 100 index on the Istanbul Stock Exchange fell 1.60 percent to close at 14,235.83 points.

stories.title: Trump: Rusya ve Ukrayna enerji hedeflerine saldırmayacak

en.title: Trump: Russia and Ukraine will not attack energy infrastructure
en.summary: US President Donald Trump stated that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to halt attacks on energy targets. He attributed the rise in diesel prices primarily to the Russia-Ukraine war rather than Iran.

stories.title: ABD'nin 10 yıllık tahvil faizi yüzde 5'i aştı

en.title: US 10-year bond yield surpasses 5 percent
en.summary: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East boosted oil prices while inflation concerns in the US intensified selling pressure in bond markets. The US 10-year Treasury yield exceeded 5 percent for the first time since October 2023.

stories.title: Türkiye'nin uzay aracı tamamlandı: Yerli araç test için TUSAŞ'a gönderildi

en.title: Turkey's space vehicle completed: Domestic vehicle sent to TUSAŞ for testing
en.summary: Turkey has completed production of its first lunar mission spacecraft, weighing approximately 3.5 tons with over 80 percent domestic components. The vehicle has been sent to TUSAŞ for environmental testing, with plans to launch it in early 2027 as Turkey aims to become the ninth country to reach the Moon.
